en.abdullah-al-shahin: 3. Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated to us, from Ali ibn Muhammad, who reported it to Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abi Basir, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah, "May I be sacrificed for you, when will the relief (al-Faraj) come?" He replied, "O Aba Basir, are you among those who desire this world? Whoever understands this matter has already found relief by awaiting it."
